# test_sacf_bp {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_sacf_bp(data, w; alpha=0.05)
```
Perform the asymptotic Box-Pierce type test for spatial dependence based on the spatial autocorrelation function (SACF), aggregating the squared SACF values over all delays up to `w`, and return a [`SACFBPTestResult`](SACFBPTestResult.qmd) with the test statistic, the asymptotic critical value, the p-value, and the reject decision.
 
  * `data::Matrix{<:Real}`: data matrix (spatial field).
  * `w::Int`: window size; delays up to `w` in each direction are used.
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.


:::
